title: Turkey Consciousness
content: Naturalist Joe Hutto, who raised a flock of imprinted turkeys, says that they are extremely smart and aware communicators.“But their ability to understand the world goes much further than just communication. I came to realize that these young turkeys in many ways were more conscious than I was”In thisnature video, he replays the experiment from his bookIllumination in the Flatwoods.He raises a bunch of wild turkeys, allowing them to imprint on him so that he's their parent. The exercise—which must have taken total commitment for the better part of a year—gives us a rare insight into theumweltof some very impressive wild animals.
